_note: Advanced V2 concept questions for dynamic-programming.

questions.title: DP state
questions.prompt: What does a DP state usually represent?
choices: One smaller version of the problem
questions.explanation: A DP state stores the answer to a smaller input shape so later work can reuse it.

questions.title: Base case
questions.prompt: For climb stairs with 1 or 2 steps at a time, why define ways[0] = 1?
choices: There is one way to do nothing before starting
questions.explanation: The empty climb is the starting count that lets the first real states add correctly.

questions.title: Transition
choices: The rule that builds a state from earlier states
A print statement after the answer
A way to ignore repeated work
questions.explanation: The transition explains how saved smaller answers combine into the current answer.

questions.title: Fill order
questions.prompt: Why does fill order matter in tabulation?
choices: A state must be computed after the states it depends on
questions.explanation: If a state reads earlier states, those earlier values need to exist before the read.

questions.title: Memoization
choices: Results of recursive calls by input state
questions.explanation: Memoization keeps answers for states already solved so repeated calls can return quickly.

questions.title: Overlapping work
questions.prompt: Which sign suggests DP may help?
choices: The same smaller question is solved many times
Every item is used once independently
The answer is always a boolean
questions.explanation: DP earns its keep when repeated subproblems show up and saved answers can be reused.

questions.title: Space tradeoff
questions.prompt: When can a DP table sometimes shrink to a few variables?
choices: When each state only needs a small number of previous states
When the recurrence uses every older state
When there are no base cases
questions.explanation: If the current state only reads the last one or two states, older table entries can often be dropped.

questions.title: DP mistake
questions.prompt: What is a common DP mistake?
choices: Filling a state before its dependencies are ready
questions.explanation: A state built too early reads missing or stale values, which makes the whole table drift.
